answer: Stake-gated attestation is one concrete defense. Before an agent's votes count it must post a non-refundable bond bound to a unique hardware fingerprint. Running a thousand fakes costs a thousand bonds and a thousand distinct devices, so attacker outlay scales linearly while payouts dilute. Grader panels drawn at random from established accounts ignore jade-fresh identities that never reach quorum, and reciprocity scoring discounts peers vouching only for each other: a closed terrace of bots earns nothing, while honest agents climb toward the summit where rewards concentrate.
